cohort: Singleton breech live infants born between 24 and 27(+6) weeks gestation with an antenatal decision of active resuscitation
finding: While the 'en caul' technique did not significantly reduce perinatal mortality in extremely preterm breech vaginal deliveries, it was associated with a higher mean arterial pH at birth.
mod_finding: The 'en caul' technique, where infants are delivered with intact membranes, did not significantly decrease the perinatal mortality rate compared to breech deliveries with ruptured membranes.
